value.rationale: A physically controlled comparison fixes gate active duty cycle at 1/2 while varying target temporal correlation. It rigorously demonstrates optimizer reentrance driven by switching timescale alone, distinguishing it from prior numerical nonmonotonic changes that alter occupancy. Two exact optimizer limiting roots and sign-controlled corrections provide useable protocol calibration at slow and fast gate speeds. It is not a formula rewrite or arbitrary parameter slice because constant duty cycle isolates the natural temporal effect.
